problem: Production Release Readback reclassified all changed files after a merge, including paths that are ignored by the workflow trigger such as skills, docs, tests and Brain learning. A mixed governance closure therefore became deployment-required even though no Netlify runtime changed.
root_cause: The workflow trigger had governance paths-ignore rules, but the internal scope derivation used the unfiltered full git diff. Trigger scope and deployment scope diverged.
fix: Filter governance-only paths into runtimeChangedPaths before createDeliveryPlan, Netlify runtime checks and website risk classification. Keep manual readback explicit and preserve real website/portal/runtime production requirements.
prevention: Workflow trigger scope and internal deployment scope must use the same non-runtime governance semantics.
Skills, docs, tests, Brain learning, AGENTS.md and canonical system-map updates do not alone require Netlify deployment.
Mixed candidates still require deployment when any runtimeChangedPath belongs to website, portal or Netlify runtime.
Manual readback may still request browser verification explicitly.
